title: Introduce shadow-migration workflow and stats-driven index tuning for control-plane
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Problem:
The control-plane has recurring incidents where online schema changes and index swaps cause transient query plan regressions and increased tail latency for tenant reads. Root causes include outdated planner statistics, heavy ad-hoc index churn, and migrations that run in-place on hot tables without a safe cutover path.

Goal:
Deliver a repeatable, low-risk 'shadow migration' workflow plus telemetry-driven index tuning so we can:
- Apply schema/index changes to shadow tables without blocking production reads/writes.
- Run delta-syncs and verification queries to validate behavior under production load.
- Automatically detect index usage and stale statistics; recommend and (optionally) apply ANALYZE/refresh on safe windows.
- Provide a runbook, dashboards, and CI checks to prevent regressions during rollouts.

Scope (MVP):
1) Shadow table framework: create shadow_<table> copies that can be kept in sync using small-batch delta sync jobs and triggers.
2) Cutover plan: dual-write gating, shadow-read sampling, verification queries for latency and plan shape, atomic switch script for minimal downtime.
3) Stats & index telemetry: per-route index hit-rate, planner cost deltas, and last-analyzed timestamps surfaced to Console.
4) CI migration guard: preflight checks that run on migration PRs to simulate plan on sampled data and flag plan shape changes.

Out of scope for MVP:
- Fully-automated online reindexing for every table (will be follow-up).
- Cross-region shadow sync (first runbook focused on single-region control-plane).

Acceptance criteria:
- A documented runbook exists in Confluence with steps to create a shadow table, run delta-sync, validate queries, and perform cutover.
- Two pilot migrations completed using the workflow (projects table and tenant_metadata table). Measured tail p95 and p99 latency before, during, after cutover show no >25% regression vs baseline.
- Console dashboard showing index usage and last ANALYZE time with alerts for stats older than 7 days.
- CI preflight job added to migrations pipeline; at least one migration PR blocked by the new preflight (demonstrates coverage).

Migration steps (MVP):
- Create shadow table schema with new indexes/columns.
- Full initial copy via background job (throttled).
- Enable logical replication for changelog or use delta-sync windowed job that replays writes to shadow table.
- Shadow-read sampling: 1% of reads route to shadow and compare rows/plan.
- Run verification suite (synthetic queries + production-sampled queries).
- Cutover script toggles read route and stops delta job after verification; mark old table deprecated.

Rollout plan:
1) Build shadow tooling and test in staging with synthetic load (2 weeks).
2) Pilot on low-traffic tenant tables (1 week).
3) Pilot on projects and tenant_metadata with close monitoring (1 week).
4) Gradual rollout to other hot tables with automated ANALYZE recommendations (2–3 weeks).

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: delta-sync lag causes stale reads on shadow. Mitigation: set SLAs for delta-sync lag and abort cutover if lag > threshold; run sampling to detect divergence.
- Risk: shadow-read sampling causes extra load. Mitigation: sample at 0.1–1% and throttle sample queries, ramp up gradually.
- Risk: unexpected planner changes after cutover. Mitigation: CI preflight checks and canary holds that pin a small percent of traffic to old path for 1 hour post-cutover.

Observability & dashboards:
- Index usage heatmap (by table/index) with weekly trends.
- Analyzer freshness: last ANALYZE timestamp per table and auto-alerts.
- Shadow sync lag metric and verification mismatch rate.
- Migration canary dashboard showing p50/p95/p99 for both old and shadow read paths across the pilot window.

Runbook and docs:
Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CP/pages/Shadow+Migrations
README (repo): https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane-migrations/blob/main/SHADOW_MIGRATIONS.md

CI and PR changes:
- New GitHub Action 'migration-preflight' that executes plan shape checks and runs small-sample queries against a snapshot. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane-migrations/pull/210

Acceptance test artifacts:
- Pilot PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/1458 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/1462
- Console dashboard draft: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/controlplane-index-usage
comments: 2026-03-06 - Kickoff: aligned with Infra and Observability leads. Decided to scope MVP to single-region control-plane and exclude cross-region sync.

2026-03-07 - Design review with DBAs: agreed on delta-sync approach using logical replication for large tables and windowed WAL-replay for smaller ones. Action: Liam to prototype replication consumer (ENG-82701).
2026-03-08 - Tooling: initial scaffolding for shadow table creator landed in repo (PR #210). Observability team to add metrics for sync lag and verification mismatch.

2026-03-10 - Pilot selection: projects and tenant_metadata nominated as first pilots. Scheduling pilot migration for 2026-03-18 maintenance window. Noted dependency on ENG-41205 for optimizer hints cleanup.
notes: Prototype checklist: schema-diff tool, delta-sync job, shadow-read sampler, verification query suite, cutover script, CI preflight. Next milestone: green run in staging with synthetic load by 2026-03-13.
